# Google Classroom

Google Classroom is a free web service developed by Google for schools that aims to simplify creating, distributing, and grading assignments

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/google-classroom/.

## Actions

- **Get CourseWork** (read-only): Get details of a specific coursework.
- **Get Coursework Material** (read-only): Get a coursework material.
- **List Courses** (read-only): List all courses accessible to the authenticated user.
- **List CourseWork** (read-only): List coursework in a course.
- **List CourseWorkMaterials** (read-only): List courseworkmaterials in a course.
- **List CourseWorkMaterials** (read-only): List course work materials in a course.
- **Create Announcement**: Create an announcement in a course.
- **Create Course**: Create a new course.
- **Create Course Topic**: Create a course topic.
- **Create Course Work Material**: Create course work material.
- **Create CourseWork**: Create a coursework item in a course.
- **Create Invitation**: Create an invitation for a user to a course.
- **Delete Announcement**: Delete an announcement.
- **Delete Course**: Delete a course.
- **Delete Course Topic**: Delete a course topic.
- **Delete CourseWork**: Delete a specific coursework.
- **Get Announcement** (read-only): Get an announcement.
- **Get Course** (read-only): Get details for a specific course.
- **Get Course Topic**: Get a course topic.
- **Get Teacher** (read-only): Get teacher enrollment.
- **List Announcements** (read-only): List announcements in a course.
- **List Course Students**: List students in a course.
- **List Course Teachers**: List teachers in a course.
- **List Course Topics** (read-only): List topics in a course.
- **List Student Guardians** (read-only): List guardians of a student in a course.
- **List Student Submissions** (read-only): List student submissions for a specific coursework.
- **Patch Announcement**: Update fields of an announcement.
- **Patch Course**: Update one or more fields of a classroom course.
- **Patch Course Topic**: Update fields of a course topic.
- **Patch Coursework**: Update fields of a coursework.
- **Reclaim Student Submission**: Reclaim a student submission for editing.
